run_apply_model: run the glassy dynamics binary to predict particle mobilities using a trained checkpoint model
run_with_data_directory: run the apply binary with a custom data directory containing aggregated dataset files
run_with_time_index: run the apply binary specifying a custom time index for target mobilities
run_with_max_files: run the apply binary limiting the maximum number of files to load from the dataset
run_with_checkpoint: run the apply binary with a custom checkpoint path to load a different trained model
